evidence.detail: Launcher owns rs/gui/J in field l and exposes it through its side-panel accessor; the panel is the container attached beside the game surface.
The panel constructs a JTabbedPane containing exact tabs Loadouts, PvP Tracker, GPU (Beta), and conditionally Development or Item Search, with fixed 344x480 child sizes.
It owns the already-recovered loadout, PvP tracker, GPU and item-search/development child surfaces and exposes typed accessors for those components and the JTabbedPane.

evidence.detail: LauncherSidePanel constructs rs/gui/L and installs it directly as the JTabbedPane ChangeListener.
stateChanged casts the event source to JTabbedPane, reads the selected index, then invokes Launcher.d() to refresh/update launcher state.
The listener holds only its synthetic LauncherSidePanel reference and owns no independent feature state.
